title: Issues, Principles and Best Practices in Language Revitalization
description: Introduces contemporary issues, principles and practice models in the revival, maintenance and revitalization of Indigenous languages in Canada and around the world. Participants identify community assets supporting individual, family and community language revitalization.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of LING 180B, LING 180.

items.text: Admission to one of BEd or Diploma program in Indigenous Language Revitalization, Certificate in Indigenous Language Proficiency, Certificate in Indigenous Language Revitalization
